rationale: The stock is at 99.6% of its intraday range, essentially at the all-day high after a 16.3% gap-up on strong earnings, with only 25 minutes to close — any position opened now faces forced liquidation at market close. Going long at the high of a massive gap-up day with 25 minutes remaining offers poor risk/reward, while shorting a stock with this momentum and news catalyst is equally dangerous. The spread and late-session dynamics make a clean entry with defined risk impractical.
